uncrpd.screenLabel: UNCRPD information and application guide screen
uncrpd.title: UNCRPD Framework & Application Guide
uncrpd.intro: The UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UNCRPD) sets out global obligations to respect, protect, and fulfill disability rights. This guide helps you navigate its core texts, General Comments, monitoring tools, and practical implementation pathways.

workflow.heading: Practical Workflow
workflow.step1: 1. Identify the relevant UNCRPD article(s) and any clarifying General Comment.
workflow.step2: 2. Map facts and barriers to treaty language (rights affected, duties triggered).
workflow.step3: 3. Collect supporting evidence (timelines, medical notes, accommodation records).
workflow.step4: 4. Frame requests or submissions using article citations + plain language impact.
workflow.step5: 5. Reference monitoring or implementation guidance for follow‑up or escalation.
workflow.step6: 6. Track outcomes and iterate – update evidence and article mapping as needed.

indicator.title: Indicator Design Tips
indicator.body: Use OHCHR model: Structure (laws/mandates), Process (program coverage, participation), Outcome (employment retention, accommodation resolution timelines, reduction in claim suppression).
